corrections_applied.issue: Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js contained hardcoded external file references (such as testsPath and direct references to evaluation-tests.md) rather than pointing to a shared configuration contract.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Added the governing rule 'shared_configuration_contract_governs_external_references' and updated all external references in the dependency chart, Step 3 glossary, evaluation requirements, supervisory gate instructions, and runtime integration requirements to resolve via config.json and its key 'external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact'.
corrections_applied.program_change: Created loadSupervisorConfig() in send-to-gemini.js to load ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json, resolve triggerPath, agentsPath, runsRoot, and step3EvalPath, and use the shared config to load the combined Step 3 evaluation artifact.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Constructed ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json declaring agents_file, trigger_file, runs_directory, and external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact (pointing to ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json).
corrections_applied.rationale: Prevents specification/runtime divergence by establishing a single source of truth for all external file paths and dependencies.

corrections_applied.issue: Step 3 relied on legacy evaluation-tests.md and step-3-test-return-schema.md instead of the canonical merged artifact step-3-evaluation.json.
corrections_applied.agents_change: Updated Agents.md Step 3 specifications to cite the single evaluation artifact referenced under config key 'external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact' for both evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr, eliminating legacy file dependencies without duplicating JSON into Agents.md.
corrections_applied.program_change: Updated loadStep3Evaluation(), contextFiles(), systemText(), supervise(), and main() in send-to-gemini.js to load and inject step-3-evaluation.json as a single parsed JSON object containing evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr.
corrections_applied.source_config_change: Explicitly defined step3_evaluation_artifact with keys 'evaluation_heuristic' and 'step3_tsr' in config.json.
corrections_applied.rationale: Directly integrates the consolidated heuristic and 97-case TSR question corpus into the runtime and supervisory evaluation pipeline.

revised_source_config.description: Shared configuration for Gemini Supervisor runtime and specification dependencies.

step3_evaluation_artifact.description: Consolidated single source of truth for Step 3 evaluation method heuristic and Step3_TSR question corpus.
